title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: exclude specific domains from web grounding
summary: Hold: the briefing says no automation is documented for the DLP web-search restriction, but the PowerShell rule reference documents an action that blocks web grounding. The domain-exclusion limits, default, licensing background and roadmap facts are supported; the control paths and Graph row need small completeness corrections.

claims.quote: Under Customization, select Policy Management. ... On the Configure Settings page, select the policies that you want to include in the policy configuration. You can search for the policy by name
claims.fix: Extend controls[1].ui.path and the rendered path to 'Customization > Policy Management > Policy configurations > Create > Start with the basics > Choose the scope > Configure Settings > Allow web search in Copilot'. The wizard route is on the cited Cloud Policy page; the policy name is on https://learn.microsoft.com/copilot/plan/manage-public-web-access.

claims.claim: The Cloud Policy UI supports tenant-wide or group targeting.

claims.claim: POST /beta/admin/configurationManagement/configurationMonitors can apply the web-search control using an applyOnce monitor and its baseline.
claims.quote: POST https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/admin/configurationManagement/configurationMonitors ... applies a desired-state baseline once in applyOnce mode.
claims.fix: Keep the call unchanged. Add to controls[1].note and its rendered note: 'Set mode to applyOnce and baseline.resources to a microsoft.copilot.allowwebsearch resource with resourceVersion 1 and properties.value as a string: 0 enables, 1 disables, 2 disables Work mode only.' These properties are documented at the existing Graph reference and https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/utcm-copilot-resources#allowwebsearch-resource-type.

claims.claim: The Purview path reaches the Copilot location in the custom DLP policy wizard.
claims.quote: Go to Data Loss Prevention > Policies and select + Create policy. ... Select the Custom template, then Custom policy. ... On the Locations page, set the Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Copilot Cowork location to on.
claims.fix: Keep the documented wizard path, but extend its note with: 'Add a rule with Content contains > Sensitive information types, then set Prevent Copilot from processing content > Performing Web Searches.' The current route stops before the deciding rule action; the full steps are on https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/dlp-microsoft365-copilot-location-learn-about#block-sensitive-information-types-in-web-search.

claims.claim: Learn documents no automation call for the DLP action blocking external web search.
claims.quote: The RestrictWebGrounding parameter specifies an action for the DLP rule that blocks web grounding. Valid values are: $true: Web grounding is blocked.
claims.fix: Replace controls[2].api with kind 'powershell', call 'New-DlpComplianceRule -Policy <policy> -RestrictWebGrounding $true', and docs 'https://learn.microsoft.com/powershell/module/exchangepowershell/new-dlpcompliancerule?view=exchange-ps'. Replace the claim of no automation in the note with 'Security & Compliance PowerShell documents RestrictWebGrounding as a DLP rule action that blocks web grounding; configure the sensitive-information condition on the rule.' Update the rendered row identically.
